g.text: Sheet 2 of 4: floor plans and section, v0.7, 2026-10-06

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a
font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Full 15 m width: about 98 m² inside, 3.0 m clear, 16 two-tier bunks =

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: 32 berths. Main bunk room with a long table; a family room with a

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: kitchen and 6 berths at the east end. Two WCs, a shower and two

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: basins; stored water; supplies; a plant room with a hand-driven

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: filter fan and batteries, sized by the norm (supply in standing format).

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Entered from the hall through a blast lobby with offset doors in a

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: 1 m wall; escape tunnel north to a hatch on the slope.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Food store access: a second lobby with offset protective doors

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: leads from the family room into the root cellar, so supplies can

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: be reached without going back through the hall.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Cited minimums: 0.5 m² and 1.5 m³ per person, 2.9 m for two-tier

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: bunks; at 30 people this gives about 3.3 m² and 10 m³ per person.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a
font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Winter garden across the front of the shelter area: entrance with round

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: main and inner doors to the west, relax area to the east. Sauna and

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: showers in the former store (sheet 3). Utility now opens off the hall.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Food store with its own round door. Co-working on floor 2: about

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: 43 m², wood stove, shower room, kitchen, lockers; the sauna flue

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: rises through it in a masonry chase.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Dimensions in metres, inside faces unless shown on wall centres;

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: door tags refer to the door schedule on sheet 4.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Dimensions are indicative. Not for construction. A bomb shelter

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: must be designed by an engineer to DBN V.2.2-5:2023 (civil

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: protection structures); permits may be required.
